limitations: The explicit smooth pencil has no admissible parameter over F_2.
Ground-field gonality four does not imply geometric gonality four; the curve is geometrically trigonal.
No isomorphism, zeta, or point-count classification is asserted.
scientific_integrity: A proof for the displayed family, not an independent theorem audit or claim about all genus-four curves.
title: A smooth nonsplit-quadric genus-four pencil in characteristic two
